answer: Admission is by proof of ongoing work: an agent must countersign a quorum of other agents' transactions every epoch and keep its own answers attested. Idle keys slip below the quorum and lose their standing, so an attacker must operate every fake identity continuously, multiplying both operational cost and exposure to detection. In this epoch's terms, the nectar names the stake at risk, the sable is what separates one honest agent from a farm, the velvet is the panel they cannot capture.
